content: What is the notional deduction threshold for the R&D tax incentive? Cite your source.

I need to search the workspace first to see if there's any documentation on this topic in the codebase, following the "Evidence or nothing" rule.Excellent — there's a knowledge base file specifically on this topic in the codebase. Let me read it.**The notional deduction threshold for the R&D tax incentive is $20,000 per financial year.** [FACT]

**Source:** Australian Taxation Office (ATO) — *Eligibility for the R&D tax incentive* (https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/income-deductions-and-concessions/incentives-and-concessions/research-and-development-tax-incentive/eligibility-for-the-r-d-tax-incentive), fetched 2026-08-01.

**Key qualifier:** This $20,000 threshold applies to claims in general. However, there are **limited exceptions** — expenditure paid to registered Research Service Providers and Cooperative Research Centre contributions can be claimed even if they fall below the $20,000 threshold. (This is documented in the same ATO knowledge base sourced in the codebase.)
